name: mame03
title: MAME 0.3 (DJGPP + Allegro, 1997)
_doc: 0.2's successor, and the release that adds DONKEY KONG -- a driver with its own video hardware rather than another Pac-Man derivative. Three releases of one program in five months is a compiler test no single snapshot gives, and each one is checked against the SAME native build of itself.
_units: The makefile's OBJS list, in its order. obj/osdepend.o has its own rule pointing at src/msdos/msdos.c -- MAME's own DOS backend, compiled rather than replaced.
_include: The makefile's -Isrc -Isrc/z80, plus src/msdos for the osdepend rule.
_defines: The makefile passes -DX86_ASM -DLSB_FIRST. X86_ASM is NOT set here: it selects the x86 assembly path, the same choice as Quake's id386=0 and Heretic's #ifndef __WATCOMC__.
